title: Material Across Facing Print Pages

illustrates.quote: Material printed and read across two facing pages of a book, when there is no other material on either page, is treated as if it were on a single print page. The combined print page numbers (e.g., 44-45) are placed to end at the right margin. If lettered continuation pages are required, they also carry the combined print page numbers, e.g., a44-45, b44-45, and so forth.

page.features: Two facing print pages (44 and 45) with a single diagram running across both, no other material on either page, so combined into one print page number '44-45' per 1.12.1.
